sloka: यो हि मत्तं प्रमत्तं वा सुप्तं वा रहितं भृशम् ।हन्यात्स भ्रूणहा लोके त्वद्विधं मदमोहितम् ॥४-११-३६॥।।
transliteration: yo hi mattaṁ pramattaṁ vā suptaṁ vā rahitaṁ bhṛśam ।hanyātsa bhrūṇahā loke tvadvidhaṁ madamohitam ॥4-11-36॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever kills a person, who is drunk or is heedless or is asleep or without weapons or stupified by lust in this world, is equal to a killer of a foetus in the womb.'
